name: WANTED: Jai'vhanel
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Attention!

A reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also know as "Swordfeather".

Unfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.

Jai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.

Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

The Auberdine Village Council
narrative.objectives: Find and slay the owl known as Jai'vhanel and take one of her feathers. The black owl was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Report the death of Jai'vhanel to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
narrative.offerRewardText: It is good to know that issue has been taken care of, but it saddens me that we could not find another way. Jai'vhanel had been somewhat of a guardian of this area for quite some time, and I am not sure what could have caused her decent into madness.Regardless, thank you for your service today, champion. The roads to Auberdine are safe for travel once again.
narrative.requestItemsText: Greetings champion - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?
